name: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises
verdict: FLAT / size zero — RP_TAINTED; no price gate (DELIBERATE)
adjudicated: 2026-08-22 (benches 2026-08-18: red 8/10 ACCEPT-WITH-CUTS of the brief's FLAT, blue 8/10 partially overturned; both converge FLAT)
ruling: The name is un-ownable on structure, not price. Surviving load-bearing findings: (1) the $2.4B Base Electron contract was BOUGHT WITH EQUITY — 0.5M shares + 10.46M warrants at $4.11 issued to the customer/its sponsor, $64.4M H1 fair-value charge, warrant amortization added back to adjusted EBITDA (the marketed profitability excludes the price paid for the revenue); (2) advance billings FELL $30.5M during the ramp — the customer is not prepaying; (3) ~$24M of $37.8M H1 adjusted EBITDA is non-cash addbacks (SBC 10x to $14.8M + warrant items); (4) the $191.7M preferred (rate-verified via the $3.715M/qtr dividend) erases the apparent net-cash. Blue's cuts adopted: AP balloon scaled to ~$29M genuine float (cost base doubled; DPO 57d ordinary); GAAP-vs-adjusted consensus artifact voided red's 'street needs the stock down' flourish; GM 'collapse' is a YoY mix/base effect.
